Translingual

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Abbreviation of English Romanian or Romanian român.

[edit]

ron

  1. (international standards) ISO 639-2/T & ISO 639-3 language code for Romanian.

English

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • Ron

Etymology

[edit]

Shortening of a corrupted pronunciation of heroin, pronounced /ˈheir.rɒn/.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (General Australian):(file)

Noun

[edit]

ron (uncountable)

  1. (slang) heroin

Anagrams

[edit]
  • NOR, NRO, Nor., nor, nor-, orn

Middle English

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Possibly related to Old Norse reynir.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • rone

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /rɔːn/

Noun

[edit]

ron (plural rones)

  1. (Late Middle English) A rowan-tree berry.
Derived terms
[edit]
  • rawntre
Descendants
[edit]
  • English: rowan
References
[edit]
  • “rōn, n.2”, in MED Online, Ann Arbor, Mich.: University of Michigan, 2007.

Etymology 2

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

ron

  1. (West Riding) alternative form of roune (“conversation”)

Etymology 3

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

ron

  1. plural of ro (“roe deer”)
